about: Fixed inputs and the exact results every backtest strategy must keep producing. They were generated by MarketLab's former TypeScript engine (the optimised cases, added later, by the Python engine 1.4.0), which the Python engine matched to the last digit; services/analytics/tests/test_golden.py checks the Python engine still does, and lib/backtest/demo-engine.test.ts checks the Learn demos' small engine on the cases it can run.

cases.name: aapl-ma-20-50-costs
cases.description: AAPL, 20/50-day crossover, $1 commission and 5 bps slippage, against buying and holding AAPL.

cases.name: aapl-ma-50-200-market
cases.description: AAPL, 50/200-day crossover, no costs, against the market index.

cases.name: two-stocks-buy-and-hold-market
cases.description: AAPL 60% and KO 40%, bought and held, $2 commission and 10 bps slippage, against the market index.

cases.name: missing-dates-two-stocks
cases.description: AAPL and KO (KO missing every 7th day), 10/30-day crossover per stock: only shared days are used.

cases.name: date-window
cases.description: AAPL, 5/20-day crossover, over a window that cuts both ends of the data.

cases.name: warm-up-longer-than-data
cases.description: 40 days of prices with a 50/100-day crossover: never warms up, so it never trades.

cases.name: commission-larger-than-cash
cases.description: $100 of cash and a $100 commission: there's never anything left to buy with.

cases.name: sawtooth-whipsaw
cases.description: A sawtooth price and a 2/3-day crossover with costs: many trades, buying near tops and selling near bottoms.

cases.name: re-entry-after-full-sell
cases.description: A 2/5-day crossover that sells out and later buys back in.

cases.name: momentum-top1-absolute
cases.description: Momentum rotation among three stocks: each month, hold the one with the best 6-month return, only if it's positive.

cases.name: momentum-top2-3m-missing-dates
cases.description: Momentum rotation: the best two of three on 3-month returns (KO missing every 7th day), no absolute filter.

cases.name: risk-parity-monthly-costs
cases.description: Risk parity among three stocks (weights by 1 / 63-day volatility), reset monthly, with costs.

cases.name: risk-parity-quarterly-missing-dates
cases.description: Risk parity between AAPL and KO (KO missing every 7th day), reset quarterly.

cases.name: rules-macd-cross
cases.description: Custom rules: buy when MACD crosses above its signal line, sell when it crosses below, with costs.

cases.name: rules-bollinger-reversion
cases.description: Custom rules: buy when the price drops below its lower 20-day Bollinger band, sell when it rises above the upper one.

cases.name: rules-chandelier-stop
cases.description: Custom rules: buy when the price crosses above its 50-day average; sell when it falls below a 22-day chandelier stop (3× ATR), with costs.

cases.name: rules-volume-breakout-two-stocks
cases.description: Custom rules on two stocks: buy when volume is above its 20-day average and the price above its 20-day EMA; sell when the price falls below its 20-day average.

cases.name: dca-two-stocks-costs
cases.description: Dollar-cost averaging into AAPL 70% and KO 30% over 12 monthly installments, with costs.

cases.name: rebalance-monthly-costs
cases.description: AAPL and KO 50/50, rebalanced monthly, with costs, against the market.

cases.name: rebalance-quarterly-missing-dates
cases.description: AAPL 60% and KO 40% (KO missing every 7th day), rebalanced quarterly.

cases.name: rules-rsi-bounce
cases.description: Custom rules: buy when RSI(14) is below 30, sell when it's above 70, with costs.

cases.name: rules-golden-cross-two-stocks
cases.description: Custom rules on two stocks: buy when the 20-day average crosses above the 60-day, sell when it crosses below.

cases.name: rules-any-ema-rsi
cases.description: Custom rules with 'any': buy when the price is above its 30-day EMA or RSI(10) is below 35; sell when the price is below the EMA or RSI is above 60.

cases.name: optimised-max-sharpe-monthly-costs
cases.description: Three stocks re-optimised for the best Sharpe ratio each month from the last 12 months, with costs (the risk-parity-monthly-costs prices). Generated by the Python engine 1.4.0. Compared within a relative 1e-5: the optimiser (SLSQP) lands a few parts in 10 million differently on other platforms' maths libraries.

cases.name: optimised-min-variance-quarterly-missing-dates
cases.description: Two stocks re-optimised for the least risk each quarter from up to 36 months, with missing dates (the risk-parity-quarterly-missing-dates prices). Generated by the Python engine 1.4.0. Compared within a relative 1e-5: the optimiser (SLSQP) lands a few parts in 10 million differently on other platforms' maths libraries.
